{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''Lorrdian resistance''' consisted of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]] who opposed their [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] overlords on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]]. Lorrdian guerrillas, forbidden to speak by their [[slave lord]]s, instead conversed in silent [[kinetic communication]]. Such silent communication enabled various factions of the resistance to coordinate their efforts silently and in public without the Argazdan's taking heed.<ref name="AE 104">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref><ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
